scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hirfacare/contracts build && pnpm --filter @hirfacare/api build && pnpm --filter @hirfacare/web build
scripts.lint: biome lint apps packages tests scripts/*.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write apps packages tests scripts/*.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @hirfacare/contracts build && pnpm --filter @hirfacare/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @hirfacare/api typecheck:test && pnpm --filter @hirfacare/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @hirfacare/contracts build && pnpm --filter @hirfacare/api test && pnpm --filter @hirfacare/web test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @hirfacare/contracts build && pnpm --filter @hirfacare/api test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @hirfacare/contracts build && playwright test
